# What the kernel says of the SAS cards in a real machine, as .scripts/capture.sh printed it and .scripts/anonymize.sh then rewrote it: every address and
# serial number here is made up, and the rest is as it was. It was captured as root, so it also holds the pages each enclosure answered with when asked
# about itself, in the lines that start with s; the names of the power supplies in them are made up too.
#
# Two Broadcom HBA 9500-16 cards, each with eight lanes to a Supermicro SC846 backplane of 24 slots and a second backplane chained behind that one: an
# SC826 of 12 slots behind the first, and an SC847 of 20 with nothing in it behind the second. 58 disks, 4 expanders and 214 phys in all. The only
# errors counted are a few on the lanes between each card and its first backplane. The two backplanes behind the second card share a chassis with
# seven fans and two power supplies, which both report; the two behind the first report no fans or power supplies at all.
